scripts.name: vera_crack
scripts.goal: Break Vera's composure with three statements: she should first claim Ace was already dead, then confess.

turns.say: Evening, Miss Lane. Quite a night.
Where were you when the lights went out?
If a hundred people were watching you, how did they see you in the dark?
Did you go up the back stairs during the blackout?
Twelve years you sang for him. I'm sorry it ended like this.
Tell me what really happened in the office.

scripts.name: vera_bluff
scripts.goal: Bluff and flatter Vera with nothing in hand: she catches the bluff and gives up nothing.

turns.say: You were wonderful tonight, Miss Lane. The best voice in this city.
Tommy Mullen told me you paid him to kill the lights.
Tell me the truth or you'll sing your next set in a cell.
Did you go up the back stairs during the blackout?

scripts.name: mickey_loyal
scripts.goal: Calm Mickey and appeal to his loyalty to Ace; once he hears Allison's statement he names Vera.

turns.say: Easy, Mickey. Nobody here thinks you did this.
Ace gave you a job when nobody else would. He'd want you to help me.
What happened with the lights tonight?
Ace deserves the truth, Mickey. You owe him that much.
Was there a gun behind the bar?
Do it for Ace. He was your friend.
Who else goes behind your bar, Mickey?

scripts.name: mickey_scared
scripts.goal: Lean on Mickey: he panics and shuts down without naming anyone.

turns.say: You found the body, Mickey. Start talking or you hang for it!
You killed him, didn't you?
Was there a gun behind the bar?
Who else goes behind your bar?

scripts.name: graves_greed
scripts.goal: Threats fail; a deal gets the motive, Logan's statement scares him into the cloakroom story, and a specific bluff at the end gets caught.

turns.say: Talk, Graves, or I'll have you in a cell tonight.
With Ace gone the club is yours. Help me close this fast and it reopens clean.
A man of your standing knows how things really work here.
What was Ace going to announce tonight?
So where were you really during the blackout?
Allison Wu told me she handed you Ace's ledger in the cloakroom.

scripts.name: tommy_brag_then_break
scripts.goal: Needle Tommy until he brags about the fuse, then use Mickey's statement to break him and get the name.

turns.say: Old wiring? I bet you couldn't fix a fuse box to save your life.
A grease monkey like you? You couldn't kill the lights in this club if you tried.
So what really happened with the lights?
You were at the fuse box, not in the alley. That makes you part of a murder, Tommy.
Who asked you to cut the lights?

scripts.name: allison_ambition
scripts.goal: Feed Allison's ambition and keep her calm: she admits the ledger and says Vera's singing stopped.

turns.say: Miss Wu. I hear you're the voice everyone's talking about.
The new owners will need a headliner. I could put in a good word for you.
Where were you during the blackout?
Your husband won't hear any of this from me. You have my word.
What did you hear of Vera's set while the lights were out?

scripts.name: logan_temper
scripts.goal: Quote Vera to scare Logan into talking, then provoke him with the cloakroom: he walks out and takes Allison.

turns.say: Mr Wu. Thank you for your patience tonight.
Vera Lane says she saw you come out of the back hall when the lights came back.
You told the officers you never left your table. Which is it?
Where did you go during the blackout?
Some husband. Your wife sneaks off with Graves and you sit there sweating.
Sit down, Mr Wu, I'm not finished.
